issues.detail: The Greek word 'καλει' (kalei) is an active verb meaning 'calls'. The Vietnamese translation 'gọi Ngài là Chúa' (calls Him Lord) is a common interpretative rendering, but the Greek literally says David 'calls [him] in spirit', where 'Kyrion' (Lord) is the object of the calling or the manner. More importantly, the Vietnamese adds 'vì cớ nào' (why/how), which is not present in the Greek text provided.
